parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small plastic button located on the front of the toaster, used to control functions such as canceling the toasting process.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to stop the toasting cycle or select specific settings by pressing it.
parts.Movement_description: It moves inward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Slider
parts.Basic_description: A plastic lever or slider on the side or front of the toaster used to lower the bread into the heating slots.
parts.Functional_description: It engages the internal mechanism to start the toasting process and hold the bread in place.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward when pushed and returns upward automatically when the toasting cycle completes.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main body of the toaster made of stainless steel, housing the heating elements and internal mechanisms.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support, heat insulation, and protection for the internal components.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation.
